title: Extracting ontology-compliant knowledge from scientific text describing irradiated materials using large language models
abstract: arXiv:2609.17291v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The quest for new materials increasingly relies on predictive models and comprehensive simulations that span scales from atomic to macroscopic levels. However, essential data necessary for these models and simulations are often embedded in scientific literature as unstructured text, limiting reusability and posing challenges for researchers seeking to leverage existing knowledge effectively. While extracting structured data from unstructured text using large language models is gaining popularity, traditional methods typically generate key-value pairs data with straightforward schemas. In contrast, we introduce eolas, a modular pipeline that uses large language models to automatically transform scientific documents into knowledge graphs aligned with a specified ontology. We demonstrate eolas effectiveness in extracting useful information for scientists studying materials designed to endure the extreme temperatures and radiation levels fou

translated_title: 使用大语言模型从描述辐照材料的科学文本中提取符合本体的知识
translated_abstract: 对新型材料的探索日益依赖于预测模型和覆盖从原子到宏观多个尺度的综合模拟。然而，这些模型和模拟所需的关键数据往往以非结构化文本的形式嵌入在科学文献中，这限制了数据的可复用性，并为希望有效利用已有知识的研究人员带来了挑战。虽然使用大语言模型从非结构化文本中提取结构化数据正日益流行，但传统方法通常生成具有简单模式的键值对数据。与此不同，我们提出了eolas——一个模块化流水线，利用大语言模型将科学文档自动转换为与指定本体相一致的知识图谱。我们展示了eolas在为研究能够在极端温度和辐照环境下服役的材料（如聚变反应堆材料）的科学家提取有用信息方面的有效性。
tldr: 该论文提出了eolas，一个利用大语言模型将描述辐照材料的科学文献自动转换为符合指定本体的知识图谱的模块化流水线，克服了传统键值对提取方法的局限性，为材料科学研究人员提供了可复用的结构化知识。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces eolas, a modular pipeline that uses large language models to automatically transform scientific literature on irradiated materials into ontology-compliant knowledge graphs, overcoming the limitations of traditional key-value pair extraction and enabling reusable structured knowledge for materials researchers.
